  1. Left elbow, aged 7. Decided to do a slow-motion cartwheel the evening that school let out for summer vacation. My head ended up landing in the crook of my elbow. Luckily, no surgery was required, but that stupid move resulted me spending the entire summer in a knuckle to shoulder cast.

  2. Left wrist, aged 16. I was walking to school in the winter and slipped on some ice. My body decided that the best way to land would be to try to catch myself with my left hand as I fell backwards. I also hit my head pretty hard when I landed.... resulting in me not really knowing what happened or being able to feel the pain in my wrist for a couple of days. Finally got my wrist checked and realized it was broken when my Mom noticed that my arm looked funny about 2 days after the accident. Also no surgery for this break... but I had a cast where I was giving everyone the thumbs up for about 6 weeks, which was super awkward.

  3. Left Tibial Plateau, aged 29. This one was the big one. I was out riding my scooter-style eBike with a couple of buds and there was a minor accident. Everything would have been fine if one of the guys hadn't lost his balance right after. He and his bike came crashing down on my knee, a weight of about 500 pounds. Crushed the top of my tibia in an area that was 35mm across and 16mm deep. Surgery to place 1 place, 12 screws, and synthetic bone. Spent a week in hospital, then had to move in with my grandmother for 2 months because we couldn't get a wheelchair into anywhere else. Lots of time in physio learning to walk properly again. Total of 5 months off work. Ended up needing a second surgery just over a year later because the hardware was causing problems (had to be removed) and the meniscus needed to be repaired. My knee still sucks and will probably never get any better... at least until I get a replacement done!
